parameters.query:
SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.delivery_address,
    o.total_amount,
    u.name AS customer_name,
    u.phone AS customer_phone,
    STRING_AGG(
        p.name || ' (' || oi.quantity || ' ' || p.unit || ')',
        ', '
    ) AS items_list
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.delivery_date = CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY o.id, o.delivery_address, o.total_amount, u.name, u.phone
ORDER BY o.delivery_address;
